_comment: dsh-proof x Claude Code — hook wiring for the evidence-driven completion proof.
Paste the `hooks` object into .claude/settings.json (project) or ~/.claude/settings.json (user);
keep this file pure JSON — JSON has no comment syntax, so guidance lives here in _comment (an
unknown key the schema ignores) instead.
The tool surface (proof_status, proof_baseline, proof_verify, proof_claim, proof_bundle) does NOT
ride these hooks — register it once per project with MCP instead:
claude mcp add proof -- dsh-proof-mcp
The hooks below add what MCP cannot give: the PreToolUse gates (evidence-store guard + baseline
gate), PostToolUse provenance observation, Stop drift detection with a one-shot no-baseline
reminder, and SessionStart policy context. They assume `dsh-proof-cc <event>` resolves on PATH;
until the package ships that bin, substitute the explicit node invocation, e.g.:
node /path/to/dsh-proof/src/adapters/claude-code/entry.ts pre-tool-use
Matched tools: Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit mutate via tool_input.file_path; Read reads via
file_path. Bash is matched so the gates can classify it, but a shell command names no path — a
Bash-written file is a deliberate path blind spot (no fingerprint, no drift attribution); prefer
Write/Edit for changes you want attributed.
Configuration (environment of the hook process):
DSH_PROOF_ROOT             workspace root (default: the hook's cwd, i.e. the project dir)
DSH_PROOF_TRUST_DIR        trust root for keys/anchors (default: $DSH_HOME/proof)
DSH_PROOF_EVIDENCE_STORE   'host' (default, store outside the workspace) | 'workspace' (.proof)
DSH_PROOF_EVIDENCE_DIR     workspace-relative evidence dir (default '.proof')
DSH_PROOF_REQUIRE_BASELINE 'off' | 'warn' (default) | 'ask'
DSH_PROOF_DRIFT            '0' disables Stop drift detection (default: on)
DSH_PROOF_ENFORCE_TURN_END '0' disables the turn-end reminder (default: on)
Set them per project via the `command` strings, e.g. `DSH_PROOF_EVIDENCE_STORE=workspace dsh-proof-cc stop`.
